title: 懸掛式單軌轉轍系統
summary: 本課聚焦懸掛轉轍的承載路徑機構定位與鎖定證據。從可動構件力行程帳建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把致動推力與獨立保持與動作回授的事件次序連成可驗證的介面，最後以維修恢復與服務條件整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies load paths, positioning and locking evidence in suspended-monorail switches. Start with force-travel work of moving members to define physical or information boundaries, connect actuation thrust and independent holding with event ordering in actuator feedback as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through maintenance recovery and service conditions. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 可動構件力行程帳與轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩
stages.titleEn: Force-travel work of moving members & Switch-linkage lever arm and torque
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「可動構件力行程帳」與「轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Force-travel work of moving members" and "Switch-linkage lever arm and torque": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 可動構件力行程帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Force-travel work of moving members: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「可動構件力行程帳」如何影響懸掛式單軌轉轍系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Force-travel work of moving members” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suspended-monorail switch systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 用假想轉轍構件的力與位移建立準靜態作功，不假定其機構等同一般尖軌。比較往返曲線的差異，找出摩擦或對位偏差可能出現的行程位置。致動器輸入能量必須支應負載作功與摩擦損失。相同行程不代表相同負載，潤滑、對位與溫度會改變力的分布；只看總電流峰值可能忽略行程中某一位置的卡滯，需把力與位移配對。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定力準靜態構件行程與定效率，不含動態衝擊或懸掛式轉轍的實際保持要求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可動構件力行程帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Build quasistatic work from a hypothetical moving member without equating it to a conventional switch blade. Compare forward and reverse curves to locate possible friction or alignment effects. Actuator input energy must cover load work and frictional loss. Equal travel does not imply equal loading because lubrication, alignment and temperature change force distribution. A single current peak can miss binding at a particular position, so force should be paired with displacement. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-force quasistatic member travel and fixed efficiency, excluding dynamic impact and actual suspended-switch retention requirements. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Force-travel work of moving members” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「可動構件力行程帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Force-travel work of moving members”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Build quasistatic work from a hypothetical moving member without equating it to a conventional switch blade. Compare forward and reverse curves to locate possible friction or alignment effects.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「可動構件力行程帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Force-travel work of moving members" is correct?
options: 致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉
用假想轉轍構件的力與位移建立準靜態作功，不假定其機構等同一般尖軌。
馬達角度已達目標就能保證懸掛式轉轍梁定位完成
optionsEn: Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking.
Build quasistatic work from a hypothetical moving member without equating it to a conventional switch blade.
The target motor angle guarantees completed positioning of a suspended switch beam.
quiz.explanation: 用假想轉轍構件的力與位移建立準靜態作功，不假定其機構等同一般尖軌。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Build quasistatic work from a hypothetical moving member without equating it to a conventional switch blade. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 可動構件力行程帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Force-travel work of moving members: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可動構件力行程帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Force-travel work of moving members” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。公式 y=F*s/eta，代入得 y=830.769 J。邊界：定力準靜態構件行程與定效率，不含動態衝擊或懸掛式轉轍的實際保持要求。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1. Formula y=F*s/eta gives y=830.769 J. Boundary: Constant-force quasistatic member travel and fixed efficiency, excluding dynamic impact and actual suspended-switch retention requirements. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。公式 y=F*s/eta，代入得 y=830.769 J。邊界：定力準靜態構件行程與定效率，不含動態衝擊或懸掛式轉轍的實際保持要求。

Boundary: Constant-force quasistatic member travel and fixed efficiency, excluding dynamic impact and actual suspended-switch retention requirements.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「可動構件力行程帳」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Force-travel work of moving members", which statement holds?
options: 油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位

Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 可動構件力行程帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Force-travel work of moving members: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「可動構件力行程帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Force-travel work of moving members” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。以「可動構件力行程帳」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions. For force-travel work of moving members, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把作用力 F 從 4500 改成 4950 N（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 830.769 變為 913.846 J。先說明「可動構件力行程帳」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only applied force F from 4500 to 4950 N (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 830.769 to 913.846 J. Explain the causal direction for force-travel work of moving members, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：摩擦增加與機構偏心都能提高能耗，但其位置依賴不同；行程結束也不等於鎖閉已被證明。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Friction and misalignment both increase energy but differ with position; reaching the end of travel does not prove locking. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。以「可動構件力行程帳」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions. For force-travel work of moving members, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

quiz.question: 要驗證「可動構件力行程帳」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Force-travel work of moving members"?
options: 在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。

optionsEn: On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures.
quiz.explanation: 在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 可動構件力行程帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Force-travel work of moving members: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可動構件力行程帳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Force-travel work of moving members” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 摩擦增加與機構偏心都能提高能耗，但其位置依賴不同；行程結束也不等於鎖閉已被證明。回到「可動構件力行程帳」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Friction and misalignment both increase energy but differ with position; reaching the end of travel does not prove locking. Trace the input chain for force-travel work of moving members. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定力準靜態構件行程與定效率，不含動態衝擊或懸掛式轉轍的實際保持要求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-force quasistatic member travel and fixed efficiency, excluding dynamic impact and actual suspended-switch retention requirements.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 摩擦增加與機構偏心都能提高能耗，但其位置依賴不同；行程結束也不等於鎖閉已被證明。回到「可動構件力行程帳」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Friction and misalignment both increase energy but differ with position; reaching the end of travel does not prove locking. Trace the input chain for force-travel work of moving members. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「可動構件力行程帳」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Force-travel work of moving members" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
摩擦增加與機構偏心都能提高能耗，但其位置依賴不同；行程結束也不等於鎖閉已被證明。
馬達角度已達目標就能保證懸掛式轉轍梁定位完成
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Friction and misalignment both increase energy but differ with position; reaching the end of travel does not prove locking.
The target motor angle guarantees completed positioning of a suspended switch beam.
quiz.explanation: 摩擦增加與機構偏心都能提高能耗，但其位置依賴不同；行程結束也不等於鎖閉已被證明。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Friction and misalignment both increase energy but differ with position; reaching the end of travel does not prove locking. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Switch-linkage lever arm and torque: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩」如何影響懸掛式單軌轉轍系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Switch-linkage lever arm and torque” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suspended-monorail switch systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 轉轍構件的力臂必須垂直於作用力，不能把連桿全長直接代入。比較不同幾何位置的機械利益，明確保留簡化定力臂未描述的死點行為。懸掛式轉轍梁的驅動力矩由致動力與垂直有效力臂相乘，連桿角度會讓有效力臂隨行程改變。馬達輸出足夠不代表遠端梁位已到達，彈性變形、齒隙與摩擦均會改變傳力；機械保持及位置確認必須有獨立證據，不能由一次成功轉動推論。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：準靜態剛性連桿力矩，不包含實際懸掛式轉轍構造、動態衝擊或額定設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use the perpendicular lever arm rather than the entire linkage length. Compare mechanical advantage across positions and retain dead-centre behaviour omitted by a constant-arm approximation. Drive torque for a suspended switch beam is actuator force times perpendicular effective lever arm, which changes with linkage angle. Adequate motor output does not establish that the remote beam has arrived. Compliance, backlash and friction affect force transfer; mechanical retention and position confirmation need independent evidence rather than inference from one successful movement. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Quasistatic rigid-link torque, excluding actual suspended-switch construction, impact dynamics and rated design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Switch-linkage lever arm and torque” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「馬達角度已達目標就能保證懸掛式轉轍梁定位完成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The target motor angle guarantees completed positioning of a suspended switch beam." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Switch-linkage lever arm and torque”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩
knowledge.text: 轉轍構件的力臂必須垂直於作用力，不能把連桿全長直接代入。比較不同幾何位置的機械利益，明確保留簡化定力臂未描述的死點行為。
knowledge.textEn: Use the perpendicular lever arm rather than the entire linkage length. Compare mechanical advantage across positions and retain dead-centre behaviour omitted by a constant-arm approximation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：馬達角度已達目標就能保證懸掛式轉轍梁定位完成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The target motor angle guarantees completed positioning of a suspended switch beam. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Switch-linkage lever arm and torque" is correct?
options: 馬達角度已達目標就能保證懸掛式轉轍梁定位完成
兩致動器瞬間速度相同就能證明已累積的位置差為零
轉轍構件的力臂必須垂直於作用力，不能把連桿全長直接代入。
optionsEn: The target motor angle guarantees completed positioning of a suspended switch beam.
Equal instantaneous actuator speeds prove that the accumulated position difference is zero.
Use the perpendicular lever arm rather than the entire linkage length.
quiz.explanation: 轉轍構件的力臂必須垂直於作用力，不能把連桿全長直接代入。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Use the perpendicular lever arm rather than the entire linkage length. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Switch-linkage lever arm and torque: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Switch-linkage lever arm and torque” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。公式 y=F*r，代入得 y=144 N*m。邊界：準靜態剛性連桿力矩，不包含實際懸掛式轉轍構造、動態衝擊或額定設計。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m. Formula y=F*r gives y=144 N*m. Boundary: Quasistatic rigid-link torque, excluding actual suspended-switch construction, impact dynamics and rated design. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用縮尺連桿同時量測力與垂直力臂，在不同角度比較力矩，再以獨立位移計核對遠端梁的位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure force and perpendicular lever arm on a scale linkage at several angles, then independently check remote beam position with a displacement sensor.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Switch-linkage lever arm and torque: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Switch-linkage lever arm and torque” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用縮尺連桿同時量測力與垂直力臂，在不同角度比較力矩，再以獨立位移計核對遠端梁的位置。以「轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure force and perpendicular lever arm on a scale linkage at several angles, then independently check remote beam position with a displacement sensor. For switch-linkage lever arm and torque, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把力臂 r 從 0.08 改成 0.088 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 144 變為 158.4 N*m。先說明「轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only lever arm r from 0.08 to 0.088 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 144 to 158.4 N*m. Explain the causal direction for switch-linkage lever arm and torque, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：連桿接近不利幾何時所需力會提高，齒隙又可能使馬達角度改變卻沒有相應梁位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unfavourable linkage geometry raises required force, while backlash can allow motor-angle change without corresponding beam displacement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Switch-linkage lever arm and torque” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 連桿接近不利幾何時所需力會提高，齒隙又可能使馬達角度改變卻沒有相應梁位移。回到「轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unfavourable linkage geometry raises required force, while backlash can allow motor-angle change without corresponding beam displacement. Trace the input chain for switch-linkage lever arm and torque. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：準靜態剛性連桿力矩，不包含實際懸掛式轉轍構造、動態衝擊或額定設計。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The target motor angle guarantees completed positioning of a suspended switch beam." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
